label: DAY 26
title: AI plays my parking game. The bot that hunts for the front spot lost by 5x.

lines.text: I always circle for the front spot.
My bot does too. Eight laps so far.

scenes.title: My game: Park Hunt

items.text: Missed them all? Drive a lap

lines.text: Wait. You made a parking game?

lines: Forty spots. Miss them, you drive a lap.
Walking counts double. Lowest score wins.

scenes.title: Avg score, 1,000 hunts each
lines: Front scored 393. Five times worse than grabbing the first spot.

lines.text: One hunt went 25 laps and gave up.
Half. It skips the back half, then takes the first free spot.

scenes.text: Skip half. Take the next free spot.
scenes.sub: Do you circle, or grab the first spot?
lines: Physicists wrote a paper on it. The one-half rule.
Do you circle, or grab the first spot? Tell me below.
